Native-safe WidgetShell covers exactly the props the call site uses (title/icon/loading/error/updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh/children): Skeleton (testID 'skeleton') while loading, an inline danger AppText error block (testID 'widget-error') on error, a titled header row (icon + uppercase muted caption title + freshness) or a title-less overlay freshness chip. DataFreshness is a Pressable(onRefresh) status dot+label whose relative time is computed once at render (no 30s interval) to avoid a dangling timer under --detectOpenHandles.

Native-safe WidgetStatusGrid: empty -> EmptyState(emptyMessage, emptyIcon); else a flex-wrap grid whose flexBasis (48%/31%/23%) targets the web container-query 2/3/4 cols, each cell a status-tinted (ok->success, warning->warning, error->danger, inactive/unknown->neutral) bordered row with a corner status dot, a truncated secondary label and (non-compact) a primary value, compact dropping the value and tightening padding (web `px-2 py-1.5`). StatCard mirrors the web data-display StatCard label/value with the `!p-2` tight padding; StatGrid lays N cards out 2- or 3-up.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output - only React, RN primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/StyleSheet), the shared apps/native AppText/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity EmptyState/Skeleton, and the native parity useBatteryCells/useVehicles hooks.
